projects.name: AI Doorbell for Home Assistant
projects.description_zh: 通过视觉语言模型比较门铃快照与已标注参考照片，并在 Home Assistant 与 Telegram 中完成识别和纠正。
projects.description_en: Uses a vision-language model to compare doorbell snapshots with labeled reference photos and handle recognition and corrections through Home Assistant and Telegram.
projects.ai_role: A multimodal AI Task agent matches and describes people from camera snapshots and reference images.
projects.hardware_role: A Home Assistant camera or video doorbell supplies event-triggered snapshots.

projects.name: Anima
projects.description_zh: 在本地网络运行 LangGraph Agent OS，自动发现米家设备，并结合环境状态、长期记忆和设备技能规划真实控制动作。
projects.description_en: Runs a local LangGraph agent OS that discovers Mi Home devices and combines environment state, long-term memory, and device skills to plan real control actions.
projects.ai_role: An LLM brain combines device state, learned preferences, memory, and per-device skills to plan actions.
projects.hardware_role: Local adapters discover, read, and control Mi Home devices including lights, air conditioners, humidifiers, and purifiers.

projects.name: Autonomous Computer
projects.description_zh: 提供 2、4、8 GPU 本地 AI 电脑的开放 BOM、CAD、装配照片、BIOS 设置和多档完整构建指南。
projects.description_en: Provides open BOMs, CAD, assembly photos, BIOS settings, and complete build guides for local AI computers with two, four, or eight GPUs.
projects.ai_role: The systems are sized and configured to run, serve, or fine-tune open language models through local inference software.
projects.hardware_role: Open multi-GPU workstation designs specify every component, enclosure, cooling path, power system, and assembly step.

projects.name: Cyclo Intelligence
projects.description_zh: 为 ROBOTIS AI Worker 提供物理 AI 数据采集、数据转换、策略训练、推理和真机执行平台，并支持 Behavior Tree 与 VLA 混合控制。
projects.description_en: Provides physical-AI data recording, conversion, policy training, inference, and robot execution for ROBOTIS AI Worker, including Behavior Tree and VLA hybrid control.
projects.ai_role: Learned policies and VLA components handle perception and actions while Behavior Trees orchestrate long-horizon task logic.
projects.hardware_role: The runtime records data from and deploys trained policies to ROBOTIS AI Worker robots through ROS 2 packages.

resources.title: Behavior Tree and VLA hybrid-control demo

projects.name: ESP32 AI
projects.description_zh: 在 ESP32-S3 上完全离线运行 2890 万参数 TinyStories 语言模型，并将生成文本输出到连接的显示屏。
projects.description_en: Runs a 28.9-million-parameter TinyStories language model fully offline on an ESP32-S3 and writes generated text to an attached display.
projects.ai_role: A quantized language model performs on-device autoregressive text generation.
projects.hardware_role: ESP32-S3 flash, PSRAM, and a wired display host the model and show its output.

projects.name: esprec
projects.description_zh: 通过 ESP32 端组件和主机工具，让编码 Agent 经 USB 串口捕获设备帧缓冲并进行真实屏幕的视觉验证。
projects.description_en: Combines an ESP32 component with host tooling so coding agents can capture a device framebuffer over USB serial and visually validate the real screen.
projects.ai_role: Coding agents invoke the capture workflow to inspect and iteratively validate embedded user interfaces.
projects.hardware_role: An ESP32 component exports the device framebuffer over USB serial for PNG or GIF capture on the host.

projects.name: findphone
projects.description_zh: 由 Claude 协助快速制作的 macOS 蓝牙 RSSI 寻机工具：读取真实设备的信号强度，以可视化仪表和声音反馈引导用户找回附近手机。
projects.description_en: A Claude-assisted macOS Bluetooth RSSI finder that reads a real device's signal strength and guides users to a nearby phone with a visual meter and sound feedback.
projects.ai_role: Claude was used to design and write the tool during its creation; the released utility does not use AI, LLMs, or agents at runtime.
projects.hardware_role: Uses the Mac's Bluetooth radio to observe or connect to nearby devices and converts RSSI measurements into a physical search aid.
projects.curator_exception_en: Maintainer-approved exception: this is a high-value AI-assisted hardware build story, although AI is part of its creation rather than runtime and the repository currently has no declared license.
projects.curator_exception_zh: 维护者批准的例外：这是高价值的 AI 辅助硬件制作案例，但 AI 参与的是创建过程而非运行时，且仓库目前没有声明许可证。

resources.title: findphone usage and Bluetooth signal notes

projects.name: Hailo Apps
projects.description_zh: 为树莓派 5 等平台上的 Hailo 加速器提供可运行的计算机视觉、VLM、LLM 与语音应用和开发管线。
projects.description_en: Provides runnable computer-vision, VLM, LLM, and speech applications and development pipelines for Hailo accelerators on platforms including Raspberry Pi 5.
projects.ai_role: Packaged models and pipelines perform vision, language, and speech inference on Hailo accelerators.
projects.hardware_role: Raspberry Pi 5 or supported computers run applications on Hailo-8, Hailo-8L, or Hailo-10H accelerators and camera inputs.

projects.name: Home Generative Agent
projects.description_zh: 将 LangGraph Agent 集成到 Home Assistant，用云端或本地模型控制实体、创建自动化、分析摄像头并提供异常提醒。
projects.description_en: Integrates a LangGraph agent with Home Assistant to control entities, create automations, analyze cameras, and report anomalies with cloud or local models.
projects.ai_role: An LLM agent uses tools for entity control, automation generation, camera understanding, and semantic memory.
projects.hardware_role: Home Assistant entities, cameras, locks, sensors, and actuators provide observations and receive approved actions.

projects.name: LightMem-Ego
projects.description_zh: 连接 Rokid AI 眼镜、浏览器前端和在线后端，将第一视角摄像头与音频流组织成可查询的分层多模态记忆。
projects.description_en: Connects Rokid AI glasses, a browser frontend, and an online backend to organize first-person camera and audio streams into queryable hierarchical multimodal memory.
projects.ai_role: LLMs, embeddings, and current, short-term, and long-term memory layers answer questions over live and historical egocentric context.
projects.hardware_role: A Rokid AI Glass Android app captures first-person camera and microphone streams and renders answers in a glasses-friendly interface.

projects.name: mcp2mqtt
projects.description_zh: 把 MCP 工具调用转换成 MQTT 命令，让大模型通过自然语言控制灯光、电机和其他联网设备。
projects.description_en: Converts MCP tool calls into MQTT commands so language models can control lights, motors, and other connected devices through natural language.
projects.ai_role: An MCP server exposes configured device commands as tools that an LLM can select and invoke.
projects.hardware_role: MQTT-connected lights, motors, sensors, and controllers execute commands and return device responses.

projects.name: Omi
projects.description_zh: 开源可穿戴与配套应用持续采集对话和屏幕内容，进行实时转写、摘要、行动项提取和个人记忆检索。
projects.description_en: An open-source wearable and companion apps capture conversations and screen activity for real-time transcription, summaries, action items, and personal memory retrieval.
projects.ai_role: Speech and language models transcribe, summarize, retrieve memories, and answer questions over captured context.
projects.hardware_role: Wearable microphones and companion desktop or mobile devices capture audio and screen context.

projects.name: Open V Robotics System
projects.description_zh: 在 SBC 与 Raspberry Pi Pico 之间建立模块化机器人运行时，把 LLM 工具调用安全地路由到电机、摄像头、传感器和其他执行器。
projects.description_en: Provides a modular robot runtime across an SBC and Raspberry Pi Pico, routing LLM tool calls through permissioned modules to motors, cameras, sensors, and other actuators.
projects.ai_role: Cloud language and realtime models select permission-scoped tools through a common adapter layer.
projects.hardware_role: An SBC handles models and UI while a Raspberry Pi Pico runs real-time sensor and actuator drivers over UART.

projects.name: OpenArm
projects.description_zh: 面向物理 AI 研究的开源 7 自由度人形机械臂，提供硬件 CAD、控制、遥操作、数据集、MuJoCo 与 Isaac Lab 训练栈。
projects.description_en: An open-source 7-DOF humanoid arm for physical-AI research with hardware CAD, control, teleoperation, datasets, MuJoCo, and Isaac Lab training stacks.
projects.ai_role: Simulation, dataset, imitation-learning, and inference components support training and deploying manipulation policies.
projects.hardware_role: Backdrivable compliant arms, force-feedback teleoperation, cameras, CAN control, and open CAD provide the physical manipulation platform.

projects.name: OpenHome Abilities
projects.description_zh: 为 OpenHome 语音 Agent 提供可扩展插件，其中本地 Ability 可运行在 Raspberry Pi DevKit 上并访问 GPIO、传感器和设备。
projects.description_en: Provides extensible plugins for OpenHome voice agents, including local abilities that run on a Raspberry Pi DevKit and access GPIO, sensors, and devices.
projects.ai_role: Voice agents use LLM routing, speech input, and callable abilities to execute single-step or multi-step workflows.
projects.hardware_role: Local abilities run on the Raspberry Pi-based DevKit and can access GPIO, sensors, audio, and connected devices.

resources.title: Companion DevKit design repository (license not specified)

projects.name: PicoLM
projects.description_zh: 用零依赖的 C 推理引擎在 256MB 内存的低成本 RISC-V 或树莓派设备上运行量化十亿参数 GGUF 模型。
projects.description_en: Uses a zero-dependency C inference engine to run quantized billion-parameter GGUF models on low-cost RISC-V or Raspberry Pi devices with 256 MB of memory.
projects.ai_role: A compact C runtime performs local LLM inference and can serve as the offline model process for an agent loop.
projects.hardware_role: Low-memory RISC-V boards and Raspberry Pi systems host the model and execute inference without a cloud service.

projects.name: reBot-DevArm
projects.description_zh: 开放机械臂结构文件、BOM 与装配资料，并连接 ROS、Isaac Sim、LeRobot 和视觉抓取工作流，降低具身 AI 实验门槛。
projects.description_en: Opens robotic-arm structure files, BOMs, and assembly material while connecting ROS, Isaac Sim, LeRobot, and visual-grasping workflows for embodied-AI experiments.
projects.ai_role: LeRobot training, Isaac Sim workflows, and depth-camera visual grasping connect learned perception and manipulation to the arm.
projects.hardware_role: Open STEP files, printable parts, BOMs, motor variants, grippers, and assembly guides define reproducible physical arms.
